title: Onboarding surge check-in (week of 2027-05-10)
body:
Objective: quick sync for the onboarding surge cohort + highlight immediate customer blockers and actions. Short, pragmatic — things to escalate, owners, and rough ETA.

Attendees: Jordan A. (lead), Maya C. (field eng), Rafael O. (SRE liaison), Priya S. (solutions PM), Evan B. (professional services).

High-level summary:
- We have five active surge onboardings this week: Aurora Health, Parcelly, Nomad Finance, Skyline Retail, and Meridian Insights. Two are in canary, one in pre-prod, two in design/infra. Overall capacity strain is medium; Dedicated pool reservations need a top-up to avoid queued requests during daytime windows (US-PST).
- Biggest risks: 1) VPC peering and route table misconfiguration causing intermittent failures (Aurora, Skyline). 2) Model mismatch regression flagged by Nomad Finance evals after quantization profile change. 3) Rollout gating missing for Parcelly — no automatic fallback policy configured.

Customer-by-customer notes:
1) Aurora Health (pre-prod -> canary target 2027-05-16)
   - Current state: Pre-prod deployment validated for basic flows; E2E tests failing for attachment-based prompts (PDF->text pipeline).
   - Root cause suspected: OCR service timeouts + KV cache TTL not primed for long-context use.
   - Action taken: Rafael applied a temporary increase to OCR timeout and disabled cache eviction for the session.
   - Next steps: Priya to coordinate with Aurora infra team to add a healthcheck route for OCR (due 2027-05-14). Onboarding team to run 200 synthetic long-context requests on 2027-05-15 to validate.
   - Escalation: If failures persist after synthetic run, schedule a 1h deep-dive with infra and SRE (owner: Jordan, ETA: 24h).

2) Parcelly (canary at 5% traffic)
   - Current state: Canary rolled out yesterday, hit 4% conversion in routing; observed 0.6% higher latency for complex multi-turn sequences.
   - Risk: No fallback policy — if model variant exceeds latency SLO, we could return 503s.
   - Mitigation: Maya provisioned a temporary traffic-split script to route >8s requests to hosted smaller model. Need to formalize in rollout config.
   - Action: Rafael + Maya to add fallback route and test in staging (due 2027-05-13). Priya to add rollback criteria to the rollout doc.

3) Nomad Finance (canary + quantization regression)
   - Current state: After applying the new int8 quantization profile (q4_0 mixed), Nomad's evaluation suite shows an edge-case hallucination in fiscal-summary prompts (precision drop ~2.3%).
   - Notes: Research flagged a specific attention kernel mismatch on seq_len 2048 when using the q4_0 mixed profile.
   - Immediate action: Revert to previous quant profile for canary threads until research gives a patch (owner: Evan; done at 2027-05-12 14:30).
   - Long-term: Research to run targeted kernel tests and a small PR to the runtime selector (linked: https://github.com/redwood/runtime/PR-2145). ETA for patch: 2027-05-20.

4) Skyline Retail (design + infra)
   - Current state: Customer requested private deployment with VPC peering and HSM integration. Network team has provided IP ranges but route-table updates are delayed due to change freeze in their corp infra (ends 2027-05-18).
   - Workarounds: Offer a hosted gateway with strong tenancy and restricted egress while their change freeze is active (provisional).
   - Action: Jordan to draft the gateway proposal and cost delta for Skyline by 2027-05-14. Rafael to pre-book a Dedicated pool slot to secure capacity post-peering.

5) Meridian Insights (design: data mapping + evals)
   - Current state: Data mapping is ~70% complete. Meridian wants a sensitivity review for PHI handling on 2027-05-20.
   - Action: Priya to schedule a compliance walkthrough with Security (owner: Priya, attendees: Security SME + Meridian data lead). Prepare test prompt sets for quality/regression checks.

Operational notes + capacity:
- Dedicated capacity: Current reserved slots are at 82% day utilization; projected to spike to 96% if Aurora and Skyline flip to full canary. Rafael recommends a short-term reservation increase of one xlarge cluster for the week of 2027-05-16 to 2027-05-23.
- Autoscaling: Queueing on the regulator has been fine, but tail-latency spikes at 99th percentile during batch flush windows. Rafael to tune the batch flush threshold (config: batch_size_threshold, current 128 -> try 96).
- Observability: Add a temporary dashboard for the surge cohort showing per-customer 95/99 p50 token latency, error rate, and billing rate. Evan to spin up by EOD 2027-05-12.

Open blockers and decisions needed:
- Security sign-off for Skyline HSM integration (BLOCKER). Owner: Security lead & Jordan. ETA request: 2027-05-17.
- Final decision on Dedicated cluster top-up (cost vs. queueing risk). Finance input requested from Rafaela (cc'd) before 2027-05-14.
- Agree on rollback criteria for Parcelly (who signs the rollback and what metrics trigger it). Proposed metric: sustained 95th percentile latency > 2x baseline for 5 minutes OR error rate > 1%.

Action items (concise):
- Priya: coordinate Aurora OCR healthcheck route with customer (due 2027-05-14).
- Rafael: pre-book dedicated xlarge cluster and tune batch flush threshold (due 2027-05-13).
- Maya + Rafael: implement Parcelly fallback route & test in staging (due 2027-05-13).
- Evan: revert quant profile for Nomad (done), add kernel test to research backlog and follow up with runtime PR owner (ETA 2027-05-20).
- Jordan: draft Gateway + cost delta for Skyline and prepare escalation plan for security (due 2027-05-14).
- Priya: schedule Meridian compliance walkthrough and assemble prompt sets for PHI evals (due 2027-05-15).

Notes to self / playbook updates:
- Add a short checklist to the onboarding playbook for surge customers that includes: VPC checklist, fallback route template, canary metric thresholds, quick-revert steps for quantization profiles, and a small 'obs dashboard boot' play to be run by SRE on day-0. Priya to own update to playbook (PR link above).

Risks low-medium but concentrated on network + quant profiles. Key escalation window: 2027-05-14 -> 2027-05-20. Recommend daily 15min standups for the surge cohort until 2027-05-20 (sync cadence: 09:30 PT).

Meeting adjourned: next full sync Friday 2027-05-14 10:00 PT. Quick check-ins as needed.

---
Raw notes / loose fragments from the call (kept for traceability):
- "Aurora's OCR timeout default is 8s, bumping to 20s reduced fail rate on sample set."
- "Parcelly is sensitive to multi-turn latency — consider caching short-term user context in the app layer too."
- "Nomad: precision drop seen only with numbers that mix commas + currency symbols, not pure numbers."
- "Skyline asked if we can offer a temporary hosted gateway with IP allowlist — sounds feasible but need sign-off from security on egress policy."

End of doc.
